info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Get Promotional Events API
info.description: The Get Promotional Events API provides access to detailed information on various promotional events within the banking marketing domain. This API enables users to retrieve event data based on specific parameters, enriching customer engagement strategies. Marketing teams, data analysts, and system integrators primarily leverage this API for reporting, analysis, and event planning. By utilizing this endpoint, organizations can stay informed about ongoing and upcoming promotional activities to better tailor their marketing efforts.

get.summary: Retrieve details for a specific promotional event.
get.description: Fetch the details of the promotional event specified by the unique identifier. This operation provides all relevant information regarding the event, including its attributes and status.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving promotional event details for a specific promotional event ID. The provided JSON should adhere to the defined schema to ensure successful processing of the request.

GetPromotionalEventByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on promotional events, specifically for the resource identified by RES-100045.
